answer: Each new identity posts a bond priced by congestion on its funding root, recorded in the shale stratum. The first identity from a root pays 28, the kth pays 28+12(k-1), so the 1000th pays 12016 and 1000 false identities pay 6,022,000 plus 60,000 locked. An auditor runs an echo check, re-reading the count and demanding the fee; a shortfall burns the bond. A root-splitting ring fails because each fresh root posts a 500 bond and seasons 30 days, adding 500,000 for 1000 roots. An honest identity pays 28 once, recovers its bond, and its excess fee becomes ember, burned.
